name: SINce Memories: Hoshi no Sora no Shita de
original_name: シンスメモリーズ 星天の下で
source:
The story follows Mizumoto Jun'ya, a college student who works at his family’s general store Mizumoto-dou. The only thing in Jun'ya’s mind is the death of his older brother Takaya who passed away the year prior. He asks himself every day why he was the one that got to live while his brother passed away.
One day, Jun'ya meets a girl who tells him, “You should’ve been the one to die,” before vanishing.

Jun'ya ends up taking on the task of renovating a traditional Japanese manor belonging to the family of Houjou Chihaya, your typical flawless ojou-sama and who happens to be his childhood friend. Since he has no idea how to even start, he’ll need to get help from various people, and he’ll need to get out of his funk to do so. Jun'ya will also have to learn how to deal with all of the emotions and problems along the way. Will he succeed in renovating the old Houjou residence? And who was that girl who told him that he should’ve been the one to die? The fate surrounding the death of his brother will soon begin.

[Edited from [URL=https://www.nintendoenthusiast.com/memories-off-spiritual-successor-since-memories-announced-for-switch-and-ps4/]Nintendo Enthusiast[/URL]]
translation:
故事讲述了在自家杂货店水本堂工作的大学生水本淳也的故事。纯也脑子里唯一的事情就是他的哥哥高也的去世，他在前一年去世了。他每天都问自己，为什么他的兄弟去世时他却活了下来。
有一天，俊亚遇到了一位女孩，她在消失之前告诉他“你应该是那个死者”。

纯也最终承担了翻修属于北城千早家族的传统日本庄园的任务，北城千早是典型的完美大小姐，而他恰好是他儿时的朋友。由于他不知道如何开始，因此他需要从不同的人那里获得帮助，并且他需要摆脱恐惧才能做到这一点。俊雅还必须学习如何处理一路上的所有情绪和问题。他能否成功修复北城旧宅呢？那个告诉他应该由他去死的女孩是谁？围绕他兄弟之死的命运即将开始。

[编辑自[URL=https://www.nintendoenthusiast.com/memories-off-spiritual-successor-since-memories-announced-for-switch-and-ps4/]任天堂爱好者[/URL]]
